_meta.description: Campaign ledger. It starts empty on purpose: a row is added only from an authorised first-party report, never from an estimate, a forecast or a figure taken from a third party.
_meta.status: Empty. No authorised first-party report has been obtained (no Associates Central export, no endpoint counts).
_meta.row_rule: Add a row only when the figures come from a report the owner is authorised to read. Record the report name, its official source URL and the date it was obtained. Do not back-fill, round or estimate.
_meta.no_forecast_rule: No conversion score, revenue forecast or commission estimate is stored here (Operating Agreement Section 4: Amazon makes no representation about the income a site will earn).

schema.timestamp_utc: When the figures were obtained, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-12-01T09:00:00Z).
schema.source: Name of the report or counter the figures came from.
schema.source_url: Official page that defines the report (Associates Central help or the owner's own endpoint documentation).
schema.channel: Traffic channel as the report defines it (for example organic search, direct, social).
schema.eligible_sessions: Integer, as stated in the report.
schema.clicks: Integer, as stated in the report.
schema.reported_orders: Integer, as stated in the report. Blank when the report does not state it.
schema.provenance_note: Who obtained the report, and anything the report excludes or qualifies.
